answer_1.quote: We evaluate LoSiA across a wide range of model scales and datasets, conducting rigorous comparisons with common baselines. On both domain-specific and common-sense reasoning tasks, the method demonstrates robust performance... training sets are sampled by 50,000 random entries from Meta-MathQA, Magicoder, and Alpaca-GPT4, respectively. The GSM8K, MBPP, and MMLU benchmarks are for testing.
answer_1.outputs: Generated text and code for reasoning and programming tasks

answer_2.quote: For GSM8K, we report 0-shot Chain-of-Thought (CoT) and 5-shot accuracy... For MBPP, we report the Pass@1 and Pass@10 metrics. For MMLU, we report both 5-shot generation and perplexity-based results.
